messages:
kai m: Heads-up: publish-typegen failed on release/v1.16. regen-check shows a removed changelog bullet for the onboarding sample app, despite the commit being present.

ci-bot: GH Actions · publish-typegen · FAILED
Job: regen-check -> non-empty diff detected
Logs: `CHANGELOG.md: removed line 'Added: sample app - auth retry example (sample-app)'`

tess y: I can repro locally. `yarn typegen` creates the bullet, but our changelog-normalizer later strips the parenthetical and a dedupe step collapses the line. That makes semver-detector think nothing user-visible changed.

kai m: annoying because the sample app intentionally adds that example to force a minor bump. We need an unblock and a long-term fix.

ops-bot: typegen v2.6.3 · Generated: CHANGELOG.md; contributors sorted

sam l: short-term unblock: push a quick commit to append ` [preserve]` to the line so dedupe won't remove it, re-run CI, then revert after a proper fix. I can do that now.

tess y: long-term: two fixes stacked: (1) adjust changelog-normalizer so it preserves bullets that start with `Added:` or contain `sample`/`Example:`, (2) add a regendiff-replay CI job that runs `yarn typegen && node ./scripts/changelog-normalize.js` in the same container image as publish-typegen to avoid cross-job drift.

sam l: also adding a semver-detector flag `--treat-normalize-delta-as-change` would let us be conservative until normalizer is stable.

kai m: can someone open an issue and assign owners? Put both fixes in the same release window if possible.

ops-bot: created issue #1724: "changelog-normalizer strips sample bullets -> semver false-negative" (owner: tess y)

tess y: picking up #1724. I'll open PR #1725 to update normalizer with a whitelist and unit tests. I'll include `tools/regendiff-replay.sh` that runs the exact sequence used by CI.

sam l: pushed temp-preserve commit and triggered CI. Re-run queued.

ci-bot: re-run triggered by sam l: publish-typegen · queued

kai m: thanks. once #1725 lands, please remember to remove the temporary ` [preserve]` suffix and re-run the publish job. Also add a short note in devex/onboarding about changelog sentinels so sample authors know the rule.

tess y: will do. PR includes guidance for updating sample-app generator to add `<!-- keep-changelog-example -->` sentinel. Adding a test fixture to ensure normalize preserves sentinel lines.

sam l: CI passed on temp commit. leaving a release board note and marking the hotfix revert as a follow-up task. :thumbsup:
